title: 第557章 参见六极宫主第556章 实打实的臭棋篓子
slug: 师妹别脑补了师兄真的是凡人
content_zh:
六极宫主带着四位长老进入天衍宗后，倒没有去别的峰上探查。
毕竟其他峰上的景色在他们的神识中就是单向透明的，唯有烟霞峰却好似有重重迷雾一般。
所以几人便径直来了烟霞峰。
“这天衍宗果然是穷乡僻壤。”
一位长老不屑地撇了撇嘴。
一路上，几人也不断地用神识探查天衍宗，发现整个宗门最强者的修为不过元婴，而那些弟子竟全都是一些筑基修为。
甚至结丹修为的弟子都少之又少。
天衍宗这等体量的宗门对于六极宫这个西漠魁首而言，简直就是一个不值一提的小势力。
几人快便来到了烟霞峰顶。
峰顶之上，一座大气奢华的庭院出现在视野中。
几人没有犹豫，直接进入了庭院之中。
然而庭院之中的景象与他们在烟霞峰外看到的穷乡僻壤截然不同。
这庭院赫然是由白玉砌成，玉质温润，隐隐有灵光流转，显然不是凡品。
而庭院中央的小巧假山，水池旁边立着一座精致的亭子，远处的几座阁楼无一不是巧夺天工。
几位长老面面相觑，眼中满是震惊之色。
一位长老压低声音道：“宫主……这庭院的规制和气派，恐怕比起我们六极宫也不遑多让了。”
六极宫主没有说话，眉头却越皱越紧。
一个小小的天衍宗，一个连出窍境修士都没有的东荒末流宗门，怎么可能拥有这样一座庭院？
这其中的蹊跷，恐怕比他想象的要深得多。
正疑惑间，六极宫主却见庭院中央，一群身穿血红色衣袍的修士正围成一圈，挤挤挨挨地站在那里。

这些修士一个个伸长了脖子往人群里张望，时而发出几声压抑的低笑，时而交头接耳地小声议论几句。
让六极宫主震惊的是，那熟悉的血色衣袍，与血刀门的制式服饰极为相似，甚至可以说一模一样！
不，这就是血刀门的服饰！
六极宫主眉头一皱，与身后的四位长老交换了一个眼神。
几人都从对方眼中看到了同样的困惑。
血刀门的人哪里有半分被人囚禁或是胁迫的样子？
分明像是在围观什么热闹。
更让六极宫主感到不对劲的是，他们一行五人就这么大摇大摆地走进了庭院，可那群血刀门的弟子竟然像是完全没有注意到他们一样，连一个回头看他们的人都没有。
所有人的注意力都集中在人群中央的那个圈子里，仿佛那里正在上演什么天大的好戏。
“去问问。”六极宫主对一个长老说道。
那长老点点头，走上前去清了清嗓子，提高声音问道：
“此地峰主是谁？出来答话！”
此话一出，那群血刀门的弟子回过头来看了他们一眼。
但依旧没有人理会他们，只有其中几人将食指竖在唇边，做了一个“嘘”的手势，便又转回头去，继续伸长脖子往里看。
六极宫主：“……”
四位长老：“……”
几人面面相觑，一时间竟不知要做些什么。
content_en:
After the Master of Liuji Palace took the four elders into Tianyan Sect, he did not go to other peaks to explore.
After all, the scenery on other peaks is one-way transparent in their consciousness, but only Yanxia Peak seems to be covered in fog.
So a few people went straight to Yanxia Peak.
"This Tianyan Sect is really a remote place."
One of the elders curled his lips in disdain.
Along the way, several people also continued to use their spiritual consciousness to explore Tianyan Sect, and found that the strongest person in the entire sect had no more than Nascent Soul cultivation, while those disciples were all based on foundation-building cultivation.
There are even very few disciples who practice alchemy.
A sect of the size of Tianyan Sect is simply a small force worth mentioning to Liuji Palace, the leader of the Western Desert.
Several people soon arrived at the top of Yanxia Peak.
On the top of the peak, a grand and luxurious courtyard appeared in view.
Several people entered the courtyard directly without hesitation.
However, the scene in the courtyard was completely different from the backcountry they saw outside Yanxia Peak.
This courtyard is made of white jade. The jade is warm and moist, and there is a faint spiritual light flowing around it. It is obviously not ordinary.
The small rockery in the center of the courtyard, an exquisite pavilion standing next to the pool, and the several attics in the distance are all ingenious.
Several elders looked at each other with shock in their eyes.
An elder lowered his voice and said: "Palace Master... the rules and style of this courtyard are probably no less impressive than those of our Liuji Palace."
Palace Master Liuji did not speak, but his brows furrowed more and more tightly.
How could a small Tianyan Sect, a low-end sect in the Eastern Wasteland that didn't even have a monk in the Out-of-Body Realm, have such a courtyard?
The strangeness in this may be much deeper than he imagined.
While he was wondering, the Master of Liuji Palace saw a group of monks wearing blood-red robes forming a circle in the center of the courtyard, standing crowded together.
Each of these monks stretched their necks to look into the crowd, sometimes letting out a few suppressed chuckles, sometimes whispering to each other.
What shocked Palace Master Liuji was that the familiar blood-colored robe was very similar to the Blood Knife Sect's standard clothing, and could even be said to be exactly the same!
No, this is the costume of the Blood Knife Sect!
Palace Master Liuji frowned and exchanged glances with the four elders behind him.
Several people saw the same confusion in each other's eyes.
How do the people from the Blood Knife Sect look like they are being imprisoned or coerced?
It was obvious that they were watching something lively.
What made Palace Master Liuji even more uncomfortable was that a group of five of them walked into the courtyard in such a swagger, but the disciples of the Blood Knife Sect didn't seem to notice them at all, and not even a single person looked back at them.
Everyone's attention was focused on the circle in the center of the crowd, as if there was some big show going on there.
"Go and ask." The Master of Liuji Palace said to an elder.
The elder nodded, stepped forward, cleared his throat, raised his voice and asked:
"Who is the peak master here? Come out and answer the question!"
As soon as these words came out, the disciples of the Blood Knife Sect turned around and looked at them.
But still no one paid attention to them. Only a few of them put their index fingers to their lips and made a "shh" gesture, then turned back and continued to crane their necks to look inside.
Palace Master Liuji: "..."
Four elders: "..."
Several people looked at each other, not knowing what to do for a moment.
